mapper.select: SELECT d.* FROM public.nocode_report_dashboard d JOIN public.nocode_report_dashboard_version v ON v.dashboard_id=d.id AND v.version_no=d.published_version AND v.deleted=0 WHERE d.deleted=0 AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND (d.owner_id=#{actor} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_report_resource_acl acl, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(acl.policy_json) member WHERE acl.resource_kind='DASHBOARD' AND acl.resource_id=d.id AND acl.deleted=0 AND (member->'actions') @> '["VIEW"]'::jsonb AND (member->>'principalKind') || ':' || (member->>'principalId') IN #{principal} )) AND (v.definition_json->>'name') ILIKE #{search} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY d.update_time DESC,d.id DESC
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dashboard WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 FOR SHARE
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dashboard_version WHERE dashboard_id=#{id} AND version_no=#{number} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_report_dependency SET deleted=1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE source_kind='APPLICATION' AND source_id=#{id} AND source_stage='DRAFT' AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_report_dependency(source_kind,source_id,source_stage,source_version,target_kind,target_id,target_version,field_refs_json,creator,updater) VALUES('APPLICATION',#{id},CASE WHEN #{number}=0 THEN 'DRAFT' ELSE 'VERSION' END,#{number},'DASHBOARD',#{target},#{version},CAST(#{fields} AS jsonb),#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(source_kind,source_id,source_stage,source_version,target_kind,target_id,target_version) DO UPDATE SET field_refs_json=EXCLUDED.field_refs_json,deleted=0,updater=EXCLUDED.updater,update_time=clock_timestamp()
